newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 16 muni bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 16 muni bond issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Wednesday it qualified for bond insurance the following 16 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Los Angeles Harbor Department, $320 million revenue bonds.
--Colorado Housing and Finance Agency, $34.495 million revenue bonds.
--West Haven, Conn., $7 million general obligation bonds.
--Urbandale Community School District, Iowa, $5 million school bonds.
--Goodhue County Economic Development Authority, Minn., $9.675 million revenue bonds.
--Clifton Board of Education, N.J., $15.3 million school bonds.
--Line Mountain School District, Pa., $4.995 million GOs, under MBIA's alternate bid program.
--Pittsburgh, Pa., $37.38 million GOs, under MBIA's alternate bid program.
--Richland County School District No 1, S.C., $60 million GOs.
--Montgomery Municipal Utility District No 40, Texas, $2.55 million unlimited tax bonds.
--Montgomery Municipal Utility District No 7, Texas, $1.19 million bonds.
